superagent.patch_note: Windows and reliability patches: accept a drive-letter absolute stateDir; filter the router tool restriction to tools the profile actually has; write worker CLI shims as .cmd files on Windows so PowerShell can execute them instead of handing them to the shell's open-with dialog; look ten minutes back on every notification poll so one slow round cannot skip a mention. The process also needs Git for Windows' usr/bin and bin on PATH for the setup probe's env and the prepare command's sh.
